nodes.name: API Documentation Policy.md
nodes.summary: Governance policy defining admissible API documentation sources, freshness requirements, and retrieval methods (Context7, web fetch, manual) for dev_graph context-pack assembly.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph governance node with standard frontmatter and a Relationships section exported to Neo4j.

nodes.name: Admissibility Checks.md
nodes.summary: Defines the nine admissibility checks (canonical flag, status, type-in-enum, frontmatter, source paths, contradictions, superseding decisions, test coverage) every node must pass before entering a coding context pack.

nodes.name: Context Pack Assembly Rules.md
nodes.summary: Eight-step assembly sequence for building typed, admissibility-checked context packs from dev_graph nodes, codebase grounding, and API docs, including token-budget and writeback rules.

nodes.name: Database MCP Mapping.md
nodes.summary: Maps dev_graph markdown nodes onto a PostgreSQL analytics schema (dev_nodes, dev_relationships, dev_benchmarks, dev_context_packs) with query patterns and a sync procedure for the postgres MCP.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines four relational tables and a relationship-type enum used by the postgres MCP analytics layer.

nodes.name: Dev Graph Governance.md
nodes.summary: Hub governance node establishing the principles, inherited and non-inherited wiki rules, node lifecycle, and relationship rules for all dev_graph operations.

nodes.name: MCP Tooling Policy.md
nodes.summary: Classifies every MCP operation as safe-automated, constrained-automated, human-review-required, or prohibited, establishing automation boundaries for dev_graph and wiki access.

nodes.name: Neo4j Export Mapping.md
nodes.summary: Specifies how dev_graph markdown nodes and their frontmatter arrays and wikilink relationships project into Neo4j labels and edges, with example Cypher and an export procedure.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines node label and edge mapping from two sources (frontmatter arrays and relationship-section wikilinks) plus example Cypher for the Neo4j projection.

nodes.name: REF - Wiki CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Read-only reference node pointing to the wiki's CLAUDE.md, capturing the governance sections the dev_graph inherits from the wiki knowledge base.

nodes.name: REF - Wiki Graph Health Dashboard.md
nodes.summary: Read-only reference node pointing to the wiki's graph-health dashboard, capturing the lint and health-monitoring patterns the dev_graph dashboard mirrors.

nodes.name: REF - Wiki Metadata Migration Plan.md
nodes.summary: Read-only reference node pointing to the wiki's metadata migration plan, capturing the schema-design patterns the dev_graph frontmatter schema adapts.
